items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: I don't know him too good, but I've heard him when I used to be in the park.

ctx.x: Did you ever play in the same band with him ever?

No, no, no. I don't know him too good, but I've heard him when I used to be in the park. See, I didn't come here until 1930, and he's famous around from 1910 to 1912, like that. You couldn't hear nothing but Buddy Bolden. You see, he was one of the old musicians, and he was famous, you see. He was strong, and he'd make up his own tone. Well, there's something different that people would be after. You see, you take like Manuel Perez, well, he was more of a music man. He had a pretty good band. He was, he wasn't…
You mentioned they wrote up in the paper about the Pickwick band. Did you ever see any pictures of the old bands in the paper, or did anybody have pictures like Bolden of those old bands?
